description: Type definitions for a Long class that provides 64-bit integer functionality including various static methods for creation, utility functions for bitwise operations, and arithmetic operations. It serves both ESM and UMD module formats.

classes.name: Long
classes.description: A class representing 64-bit two's complement integers with extensive static methods for creation and manipulation, supporting both signed and unsigned variants.

methods.name: constructor(low: number, high?: number, unsigned?: boolean); constructor
methods.description: Constructs a 64-bit Long instance from low and high 32-bit signed integers, with optional unsigned flag.

methods.name: static MAX_UNSIGNED_VALUE
methods.description: Maximum value for an unsigned Long.

methods.name: static MAX_VALUE
methods.description: Maximum signed Long value.

methods.name: static MIN_VALUE
methods.description: Minimum signed Long value.

methods.name: static NEG_ONE
methods.description: Signed value representing negative one.

methods.name: static ONE
methods.description: Signed value representing one.

methods.name: static UONE
methods.description: Unsigned value representing one.

methods.name: static UZERO
methods.description: Unsigned zero.

methods.name: static ZERO
methods.description: Signed zero.

methods.name: getHighBits
methods.description: Returns the high 32 bits as a signed integer.

methods.name: getHighBitsUnsigned
methods.description: Returns the high 32 bits as an unsigned integer.

methods.name: getLowBits
methods.description: Returns the low 32 bits as a signed integer.

methods.name: getLowBitsUnsigned
methods.description: Returns the low 32 bits as an unsigned integer.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Returns a Long representing the sum of this and another Long-like value.

methods.name: and
methods.description: Returns the bitwise AND of this Long and the specified Long-like value.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares this Long's value with another Long-like value.

methods.name: div
methods.description: Returns this Long divided by the specified divisor.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Tests if this Long's value equals another Long-like value.

methods.name: getNumBitsAbs
methods.description: Returns the number of bits needed to represent the absolute value of this Long.

methods.name: greaterThan
methods.description: Tests if this Long's value is greater than the other.

methods.name: isEven
methods.description: Checks if the Long's value is even.

methods.name: isNegative
methods.description: Checks if the Long's value is negative.

methods.name: isOdd
methods.description: Checks if the Long's value is odd.

methods.name: isPositive
methods.description: Checks if the Long's value is positive or zero.

methods.name: isSafeInteger
methods.description: Tests if this Long can be safely represented as a JavaScript number.

methods.name: isZero
methods.description: Checks if this Long's value is zero.

methods.name: lessThan
methods.description: Tests if this Long's value is less than the other.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Returns this Long multiplied by another Long-like value.

methods.name: negate
methods.description: Negates the Long's value.

methods.name: not
methods.description: Returns the bitwise NOT of this Long.

methods.name: shiftLeft
methods.description: Returns this Long shifted left by the specified number of bits.

methods.name: shiftRight
methods.description: Returns this Long shifted right arithmetically.

methods.name: shiftRightUnsigned
methods.description: Returns this Long shifted right logically.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Returns the difference between this Long and another Long-like value.

methods.name: toBigInt
methods.description: Converts this Long to a bigint.

methods.name: toInt
methods.description: Converts this Long to a 32-bit signed integer.

methods.name: toNumber
methods.description: Converts this Long to a JavaScript number.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts this Long to its string representation, optionally in a given radix.

methods.name: toUnsigned
methods.description: Converts this Long to its unsigned equivalent.
